summary: Web regression of all upload flows after uploads.ts refactor (Android permission skip + picker try/catch) + expo-image-loader dependency verification. ALL UPLOAD FLOWS PASS on web (16/16 after retest): (a) logo upload on /dashboard/profil — picker opens, preview shows new img, save-profil PUTs and persists logo_url, login page renders the new logo after logout; (b) banner upload — first run false-failed due to my test racing the in-flight upload (clicked save while uploadAsset still running because old banner img satisfied the preview selector); focused retest with PUT payload capture confirmed PUT body contains the new /api/files/ URL and it persists in MongoDB; (c) product photo upload in product-form — pick/preview/save/listed/deleted via UI (soft-delete confirmed in DB); (d) buyer bukti bayar on /order/[id] — upload-bukti opens picker, bukti-preview renders, backend sets status menunggu_konfirmasi (verified in UI text AND MongoDB); (e) chat image on /chat — chat-image opens picker, image message with /api/files/ src appears. Build-time fix verified: package.json lists expo-image-loader ~57.0.1 and node_modules/expo-image-loader (v57.0.1) exists. Regression: admin login, buyer login (lands /toko), storefront /home all fine. No deprecated expo packages detected in reviewed files.
action_items: OPTIONAL (minor UX hardening, not a regression): save-profil button stays enabled while an image upload is in flight (uploading state) — tapping Simpan mid-upload persists the OLD image url. Consider disabling save-profil while uploading !== null.
Android-specific native fix (expo-image-loader bundling, permission skip) cannot be verified headless — verify on a real APK build/device.
critical_code_review_comments: uploads.ts refactor is correct for web: ensureMediaPermission returns ok immediately on Android only; web/iOS path unchanged; pickImages wraps launchImageLibraryAsync in try/catch and pickAndUploadImages surfaces { error } to callers — all 4 call sites (profil.tsx, product-form.tsx, order/[id].tsx, chat.tsx) render the error via toast/alert instead of hanging.
uploadAsset web branch still uses Blob + no manual Content-Type — verified working (all uploads returned /api/files/ URLs and rendered).
POST /api/orders/{id}/bukti (server.py:918-930) sets status=menunggu_konfirmasi along with bukti_bayar_url — matches review expectation.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all API calls 200, persistence verified via MongoDB)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (16/16 steps after retest of banner; initial run 14/16 with 2 test-script artifacts, no app bugs)
